function: p. 4-9: Multi-task over-the-air aggregation of FL gradients at a multi-antenna server: closed-form analog beamforming against inter-task interference, MMSE digital combiner and SCA power control.
system: p. 3-4: K single-antenna devices (K=20 or 100), server with Nr analog phase shifters and N RF chains in a sub-connected hybrid array, no RIS; frequency band not stated.
method: p. 4, 12-13: FL of CNNs with FedAvg (and IFCA clustering) over AirComp; beamformer is closed-form analog phases, MMSE combiner and SCA power optimization, not learned.
data_channel: p. 5, 10, 12: Simulated i.i.d. complex Gaussian uplink channels CN(0, I) with unit path loss; MNIST, CIFAR-10 and Federated EMNIST for the learning tasks.
test_conditions: p. 10-14: Same simulated channel model; figures sweep Nr, tasks N, SNR, phase-shifter bits b, channel accuracy rho and K, with i.i.d. and non-i.i.d. data.
baselines: p. 6, 12-13: MMSE with equal power allocation (MMSE+EPA), random orthogonalization (RO) [37] with fully-digital or limited RF chains, and an ideal error-free FL benchmark.
metrics: p. 10-13: Sum MSE of aggregation, interference power, SIR, achievable MSE region, algorithm convergence iterations, and test accuracy versus communication rounds.
complexity: p. 10: Algorithm 1 complexity O(log(1/mu) K^6.5), mu the SCA convergence accuracy; no runtime reported.
openness: none; no code or data link in the paper; only public MNIST, CIFAR-10 and Federated EMNIST are used (pp. 12-13).
q1_support: p. 5: "hi,l,t ∼ CN (0Nr ×1 , INr )"; i.i.d. complex Gaussian simulated channel with unit path loss (p. 10), no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data.
q2_support: p. 13: "Test accuracy of multiple FL tasks versus communication rounds"; each setting (Nr, b, K, N, SNR) is a separate run on the same channel model, and no model trained in one setting is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 12: "the scheme using equal power allocation and the corresponding optimal combiner" (MMSE+EPA, non-learned); RO [37] is the earlier published design (p. 6); sum MSE compared in Figs. 6-8. See notes.
q4_support: p. 10: "Algorithm 1 is given by O log (1/μ) K 6.5", read as complexity O(log(1/mu) K^6.5) of the SCA power design, with mu the convergence accuracy.
q5_support: p. 12: "datasets, i.e., MNIST and CIFAR-10, respectively"; learning-task datasets only, the channel is simulated, and no code or data link appears.
notes: Include, area 7: the paper designs over-the-air (AirComp) aggregation of several FL tasks with hybrid beamforming at the server (abstract p. 1; model pp. 4-5), so the learned element is the FL-trained CNN, which passes no_learning under the FL-over-the-air rule, although the beamformer itself is closed-form and SCA optimization. The server has Nr antennas, so the single-antenna rule does not apply, and the phase shifters belong to the hybrid array, not to a RIS. Area 7 wins over area 3 by the tie-break order. Results are simulated MSE and test accuracy (pp. 10-14). q3 is judged met: RO [37] is an earlier published aggregation design and MMSE+EPA is the authors' simple non-learned baseline, so the reviewer should confirm this reading of the FL-over-the-air baseline rule.
